name: Update Attributes
notes: From entity type, effects, equipment. Decided DERIVED after measuring 4,360 packets in 7 captures: 76% arrive with a spawn (initial values), 5% follow sprint, game mode, effect or equipment changes, 19% re-send an unchanged base value, none was a server-specific change. The reader counts initial/unchanged/changed so a hybrid case would show. Decode attribute IDs from raw bytes (the parser mislabels them)
